title: Scope and delivery baseline
story: As the team coordinator, I want a shared scope so that every deliverable describes the same product.
criteria: Document current stack, Group 2, 28 October demonstration and remaining acceptance boundaries.

title: Authentication and role boundaries
story: As a user, I want assigned access so that protected employee information stays within my role.
criteria: Verify HR-only full records, own-team schedules, employee ownership and session revocation.

title: Employee records and real deletion
story: As HR, I want current employee records so that searches and totals reflect the workforce.
criteria: Seven information groups; name required; correct CRUD and deletion of linked access.

title: Manual team schedules
story: As a supervisor, I want to arrange my team week so that employees know when to work.
criteria: Five days and two distinct fixed shifts; invalid revisions preserve saved weeks.

title: Personal schedule and check-in
story: As an employee, I want my own shifts and a workplace check-in so that I can follow my work arrangements.
criteria: Own account only; reject remote check-in; retries do not duplicate records.

title: Class diagram and code mapping
story: As a developer, I want a class model so that the team can explain the implementation.
criteria: Five actual model classes, methods, multiplicities and table mapping.

title: Formal test plan and evidence
story: As a tester, I want clear GUI steps so that another group can execute the tests.
criteria: Expected results, actual local evidence, unexecuted independent tests and defect outcomes kept distinct.

title: Browser and responsive review
story: As a user, I want readable forms so that I can complete tasks without scripts.
criteria: Desktop and mobile emulation; real browser CRUD, schedule validation and check-in; JavaScript disabled.

title: English final presentation
story: As a presenter, I want a short evidence-based story so that the class understands the problem, product and process.
criteria: About ten minutes, actual screenshots, code walkthrough, AI role and team reflection.

title: Team rehearsal and actual reflection
story: As a team member, I want a timed rehearsal so that our delivery is clear and our contribution claims are accurate.
criteria: Each member verifies their own section; record rehearsal time, issues and genuine lessons.

title: Independent cross-group testing
story: As a peer tester, I want to execute the other group’s plan so that an independent test report can be produced.
criteria: Requires the other system, its plan and actual execution results.

title: Teacher demonstration and acceptance
story: As the client, I want to review the release so that acceptance findings are recorded.
criteria: 28 October review; record findings and decisions without pre-filling an approval.
